Query classification plays a crucial role in e-commerce, where the goal is to assign user queries to appropriate categories within a hierarchical product category taxonomy.
we propose a novel approach named hierarchical contrastive learning framework for query classification (HCL4QC)

We conduct experiments on two real-world datasets to demonstrate the superiority of our hierarchical contrastive learning.
